epaPlastic.note: Mechanical recycling predominates, but variable plastic inputs can yield inconsistent material properties.

waData.note: State waste and recovery datasets are available for investigation; local stream volumes have not been extracted.

waTires.note: Waste-tire collection, transport and storage are regulated; local eligibility must be reviewed before activity.

epaTire.note: Crumb rubber production separates rubber from reinforcing steel and fabric; product exposure and environmental performance need application-specific review.

arsOrchard.note: A California almond-orchard comparison reported 49% of initial wood carbon remaining after four years and modeled 6.6% at year 20. Early nitrous oxide emissions increased relative to controls; early bearing-year yields did not differ significantly. Results are not Yakima measurements or biochar performance.

arsBiochar.note: USDA describes biochar as a heterogeneous biomass-derived carbon material; crop responses vary and can be negative. Local net benefit and economics remain unverified.

doeHeat.note: DOE estimates industrial energy losses as waste heat at 20–50% of input across industry; this is not a site-specific recoverable fraction. Material constraints and maintenance costs can limit adoption.
